prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
EDIT TARGET: image 1, one full-body Taego tiger cutout. Change ONLY the framing and transparency. Preserve the exact current identity, expression, adult feline proportions, directional fur, stripe pattern, one left-chest teal/gold three-curl badge, FOUR existing legs, FOUR existing paws and ONE complete tail. Do not redesign or re-pose the tiger.
Uniformly reduce the ENTIRE tiger inside the same landscape 3:2 canvas. Target subject height 70–74% of canvas, width proportional to its unchanged aspect ratio. Center the bounding box of ALL nonzero-alpha pixels, including whiskers and faint residual pixels. Leave at least 10% of the canvas completely transparent on EVERY side. The entire subject including whiskers must sit comfortably inside those margins. Keep all four legs and four paws separately readable.
Remove all background/haze pixels and do not create new shadows, glow, floor, halos, scenery, text, outlines or checkerboard. Produce actual RGBA transparency, not a black or brown background. Preserve the subject itself and its natural fine fur edges. Single tiger, one pose, no sheet.
